workflow: An optimizer promotes a mutable attribute lookup to a constant and specializes later execution based on the constant's type.
The underlying attribute is changed while the optimized code remains active, but the promotion was not registered for invalidation when that attribute changes.
Execution continues using the stale constant under the old type assumption.
A specialized operation asserts the assumed type and terminates instead of deoptimizing or reloading the updated attribute.
summary: Untracked mutable-attribute promotion leaves stale specialized code
decision_reason: The failure is distinct from the existing stale-optimization cluster because the specialized code is never invalidated: dependency tracking is missing when the mutable attribute is promoted, rather than an invalidation event failing to remove or disable already-obsolete specialized paths.
